_about: Product-intent confirmation record. One row per submitted link. intended_asin, official_listing_url and listing fields are copied only from the official Amazon page observed on confirmation_date. observed_redirect_target is a separate field and is never merged with intended_asin. Blank = not confirmed. Prices and star ratings are intentionally not stored (Participation Requirements 2(b), 6(t)).
observation_method: Each submitted link was opened with an unauthenticated HTTP fetch that follows redirects (no Associates login, no browser session). The final URL is the observed redirect target. Title and breadcrumb were read from that returned document.

products.intended_asin_basis: ASIN read from the product page the submitted link opened on 2026-11-20. Owner has not separately confirmed intent (FLG-002).
